messages:
sophie: Hey — seeing a weird "sawtooth" pattern in org-level throttles this morning. Per-project tiles look normal but org pool is returning intermittent 429s every ~2min. Anyone else?
ajay: I saw a spike in 429s in the logs around 07:10 UTC, curious if it's the rolling-window math. Can you paste the project ids?
sophie: proj-78 & proj-82. Quick repro: make ~2k small requests each for both projects for 5 mins and you'll see bursts, dashboard stays stable though.
maria: sending logs to thread. digest shows org_meter increments jump then decay: `org_tokens +12000`, then `-7000` within window. Looks like double-counting on rollover.
sophie: exact CLI I ran:
```bash
for i in {1..2000}; do curl -s -X POST $URL -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}' >/dev/null; done
```
kevin: can you dump the realtime-meter ledger for the org? `SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE org_id='org-13' AND ts > now()-10m` — want to see shard attribution.
billing-bot: FYI invoices won't reflect transient meter changes until end-of-billing-cycle; but dashboards should align with realtime meter.
ajay: hypothesis: rolling window alignment mismatch between per-project counters (60s sliding) and org aggregation (per-shard 60s but wall-clock aligned to minute). That could create sawtooth when shards roll at different offsets.
support-ops: I reproduced locally with a smaller cluster — found Redis TTLs for prefix counters are set to 59s while others use 61s, leads to short overlap and partial double count.
maria: aha — there's also a recent deploy that changed the shard-gc timer from 60s to 65s (PR #2245). Probably the root.
sophie: wow. So fix is to align TTLs and GC timers. Any quick mitigation? Canary fallback to per-project enforcement?
kevin: immediate mitigation: enable org-level token cap enforcement to use sum of deterministic counters (non-overlapping) — flip in config `org.enforce.strict=true` for affected region.
ajay: will open a rollback PR for the GC timer. Also adding an integration test that asserts TTL parity across shards.
support-ops: we've toggled `org.enforce.strict=true` for eu-west and us-east. Monitoring now.
sophie: after toggle, 429s dropped 95% within 3 minutes. Dashboard still shows small discrepancy (~2%) vs ledger but trending down.
billing-bot: note to billing folks: small variance expected while we reconcile counters; email will go out if invoice differences exceed 1%.
maria: follow-up actions: 1) revert PR #2245, 2) add TTL check to deployment CI, 3) add alert for shard-TTL drift >2s. I'll file a checklist.
sophie: thanks team. Please ping when PR merged and when dashboards fully reconciled.
ajay: PR opened: https://git.redwoodinc/repo/pull/2289 — rolling back timer. CI added.
kevin: monitoring dashboards — org 429s back to baseline. closing loop in 2h unless anything else.
sophie: :thumbsup: good work everyone — please add postmortem note to thread when done.
